description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Spell Focus (Illusion)

Benefit: As long as you have an illusion spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you are able to produce threatening figments that threaten opponents and allow allies to flank, and can lash out dealing 1d4 damage per level of your highest-level illusion spell as a standard action. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting illusion spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Spell Focus (Illusion)
